messages:
sanjay: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing a conservative phased rollout for the new tile-facade refactor. Goal: reduce coupling, limit hotpath impact, and provide deterministic rollback.

kevin: +1. Outline phases? curious about perf delta and fast-path options.

sanjay: Phase A: proto-only adapters deployed (no traffic). Phase B: shadow (mirror requests) for 10-14d. Phase C: canary cohorts (3% -> 30%) with automatic fallback. Phase D: full ramp.

maria: we'll need cohort tagging in traces (dev / pilot / affinity / general) so dashboards compare like-for-like. I'll own dashboards and synthetic evals.

dmitri: For affinity tenants allow in-process fast-path to avoid RPC serialization. Safety: per-tenant QPS cap + circuit breaker + health checks.

elaine: CI rules: proto changes fail unless compat-check passes and migration notes included. Add tools/proto-check job that runs on PRs.

kevin: Perf note: in microbench, co-located RPC added ~1.6ms median; in-process ~0.2ms. I'll run mixed workload benches (short/long seqs) and tune cache TTLs. Target 7 days.

maria: Monitoring guardrails: per-cohort p50/p95, semantic regression on eval set, cache-warmth, cost-per-token delta. Auto-throttle cohort if cost delta > 12% or p95 reg > 20%.

sanjay: Shadow->canary gating: semantic regressions <1% on evals for 48h, cost within budget, and no critical debt items in the debt-ledger.

dmitri: Add debt-ledger entries per tile listing known gaps (ordering edge cases, eviction races, telemetry holes). Owners must sign off before cohort promotion.

elaine: Ops runbook (short): 1) enable shadow for cohort A, 2) run evals + cost check, 3) canary 3% for 24h, 4) ramp by 10% increments, 5) rollback steps: flip toggle -> drain -> scale down -> purge/backfill KV state; document RTO/RPO.

ops-bot: deploy: shadow cohort A started 2026-03-24T17:08:43Z  job=deploy-1739-shadow-A

kevin: I'll deliver the adapter shim + perf numbers.

maria: I'll post dashboards + synth links and wire cost alerts to billing.

sanjay: I'll draft the RFC addendum with phases, owners, CI checklist, debt-ledger template, and rollback playbook. Review pairing tomorrow 11am PT.

elaine: +1 to review proto compatibility and rollback.

dmitri: +1 on safety leash and debt gating.

kevin: :thumbsup:

sanjay: Thanks all  will post addendum here when ready.
